page.overview:
Who is Aric Thorne?

Sergeant Aric Thorne was a soldier of House Atreides.

Aric Thorne was born on Caladan to Fiona Thorne. He was a member of Gurney's Own, an elite strike force that served House Atreides in the War of Assassins. He was part of a raid against a position of House Harkonnen in Three Rock Station. Between battles, Aric sent recordings to his mother in which he spoke of his belief in the Atreides' cause despite the hardships they faced. As the conflict continued, many Atreides soldiers died, including dear friends of Aric's. The horrors he witnessed caused Aric to lose his faith in the conflict, including seeing Atreides operatives committing despicable acts. He told his mother that he feared he would never see her again and was declared missing later that same month. His disappearance devastated his mother and caused her to question the purpose of the war.

Redondo Monroe played recordings of Aric's messages and Fiona's diaries on an episode of Through Their Eyes: Firsthand Accounts from the Frontlines, though much of the recordings were heavily edited due to her critical and damaging comments about the war.
